title: Big Texas Little Film Tour brings Stop #6 to Casa Ortiz on Friday, Oct. 30
excerpt: The Big Texas Little Film Tour makes its sixth stop at Casa Ortiz in Laredo on Friday, Oct. 30, with a short film program at 7:30 p.m. followed by a filmmaker Q&A at 9:00 p.m.
content:
The Big Texas Little Film Tour is bringing its sixth stop to Casa Ortiz in Laredo on Friday, Oct. 30, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The evening features a short film program at 7:30 p.m., followed by a filmmaker Q&A at 9:00 p.m.

The event takes place at Casa Ortiz, 915 Zaragoza St. in Laredo.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times
